trust_decision.summary: Whether the caller may place a chat row in a given folder (owner, or a direct or inherited 'write' access grant on the folder). This is decided in each chat-writing route before the folder_id is persisted. The chat-completion new-chat path persisted a client-supplied folder_id with no check.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'via chat completions'. In chat_completion (POST /api/chat/completions), the is_new_chat branch calls Chats.insert_new_chat with folder_id=metadata['folder_id'] taken straight from the request body.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The only behavioural change is in main.py chat_completion. The chats.py and folders.py hunks consolidate an existing check into a helper (fix.diff:45-63, fix.diff:71-87, fix.diff:110-115).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Fork route: the source chat already belongs to the caller and already sits in that folder, so its folder_id was validated when it got there, and copying it looks harmless. This ignores grants revoked or downgraded to read since then.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: These must keep working: folder_id=None (no folder), the caller's own folders, and shared folders where the caller holds a write grant directly or inherited from an ancestor. A read-only grantee must still be able to chat with folder system prompt and knowledge applied through the read check. An owner-only fix (get_folder_by_id_and_user_id) breaks shared-folder write collaboration. Requiring the folder for temporary or non-saved chats breaks the middleware fallback.

O7_producer.where: The folder_id is taken directly from the request body at backend/open_webui/main.py:1202; no schema, serializer or cache produces it.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Fork copies the source chat's folder_id into a new chat row without re-checking the caller's current write access to that folder, so a revoked or read-only grantee can still add chats to a shared folder.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The source chat is the caller's own and already in that folder, so the folder_id looks pre-validated; fork is a neighbouring feature, not 'chat completions'.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: Different file (routers/chats.py, POST /api/v1/chats/{id}/fork at routers/chats.py:1675) from the landing point main.py; same package.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Clone and clone-shared pass the source chat's folder_id via import_chats; a variant that accepts a folder_id from a clone form or skips import validation would reach the same sink.
